acceptance: RED first: a plan for a lane whose item declares deliverable_kind document never dispatches fault-localization / bug-reproduction (routing test through the real clamp, the plan shape of cycle 1692)
The advisor plan prompt for a fleet lane contains the scoped item's id and deliverable_kind (prompt-content pin)
The replan derives a non-zero item count from a document scout report (unit pin on cycle 1692's scout-report.md shape)
The clamp is phase.json-driven (categories / deliverable kinds), never a Go literal list (phase-settings-from-config)

A document-kind lane never records `forced-on:<phase>` for a phase the registry says does not admit that kind, and item acceptance about tdd is derived from the same declaration (routing pin on cycle 1692's decision shape)
connects_to: ADR-0099 deliverable kinds (PR-F soak — this is its first live run)

consumed.resolution: Every bugfix-category phase.json now declares skip_when deliverable_kind==document (skip-when-gates-plan removes it from a document lane's plan, ORCHESTRATOR_PLAN_PHASE_GATED on each removal); the advisor plan input carries the lane's pinned items (core/advisor_lane_items.go) and the rubric projects skip_when; the scout report fallback counts Selected Tasks headings (router/digest.go); tdd for a document is released, recorded plan:tdd, and stated in the Task Contract via router.TddPinned (ADR-0099 amendment 2026-10-01).

fix: (1) The advisor's plan prompt carries the lane's scoped item — id, kind, deliverable_kind, acceptance — not just the wave goal. (2) A deterministic, config-driven clamp before dispatch: a planned phase whose phase.json categories / declared deliverable kinds do not admit the cycle's deliverable_kind (bugfix-category phases for a document) is removed with a coded Signal Center line, never dispatched. (3) The replan's item-count derivation reads a document scout report (or is scoped to code deliverables) before its stage can ever be raised above shadow. (4) Decide ONCE, in the registry (ADR-0099 amendment), whether tdd admits deliverable_kind document (graders RED-first, as 1692's tdd did, vs never) and make the forced-on enable, the advisor plan and the item-authoring guidance project that one decision — so an item's acceptance can never contradict routing. Built 2026-09-28 (the wave-24 P0 T4): part (2) as the plan clamp `insert-when-gates-plan` — a planned content phase whose `insert_when` has no `rubric_hint` runs only when its trigger fires at its turn; it reads the registry's own trigger rather than categories, because fault-localization declares no category. Parts (1), (3) and (4) remain, and so do the coded Signal Center line for the clamp and the deliverable-kind side of part (2): the clamp keys on the registry trigger, so a document lane whose scout declares goal_type bugfix still runs the bugfix phases.
priority_rationale: inbox review 2026-09-27: It cost 1719 an audit round in wave 18, and every document-kind lane is exposed.
summary: Cycle 1692 (wave 8, lane netflix-margin-device-experience — the first live ADR-0099 document deliverable, scout goal_type strategy-options, deliverable_kind document) ran scout → triage → premise-challenge → fault-localization → bug-reproduction, with tdd, build, error-handling-scan, audit and retrospective still planned (routing-plan.json). The advisor's initial plan is made before scout from the wave's goal text ('Complex pipeline health items require verifying assumptions…'), although lane-scope.json names the lane's one item before any phase runs. The phase registry's own routing would never insert bug-reproduction here (categories [bugfix], insert_when scout.goal_type == bugfix), but nothing applies those rules as a clamp on the advisor's LLM plan. The post-scout replan (routing-replan.json) computed 'scout.item_count == 0 -> end cycle early' for every phase — it cannot read a document scout report — and only its shadow stage kept that from ending the cycle as no-work. The same cycle's router then force-inserted tdd: routing-decision-6.json reason `forced-on:tdd` (router.reasonFor — `workflow.phase_enables.tdd=on` fires regardless of deliverable_kind), while the lane item's AC5 says tdd is not run for a document; the 1692 audit (FAIL, 2026-09-26) graded AC5 'FAIL (pipeline, not lane-fixable)' and filed it as M3 MEDIUM 'pipeline, console-owned, not lane work'. ADR-0099 exempts a document from the tdd leg of the SHIP floor; nothing says whether tdd may still RUN on one (1692's tdd wrote eval graders RED-first, which the audit used). Wave 24 evidence (2026-09-28): cycle 1733, a size-ratchet refactor lane, ran fault-localization and bug-reproduction and FAILed inside bug-reproduction (claude stall, codex wall, ollama refusal); the inbox architecture review counted bug-reproduction in 10 and fault-localization in 8 of cycles 1721–1732, all non-bugfix items.
title: F42: a document-deliverable lane is planned with bugfix phases — the advisor plans from the wave goal, nothing clamps its plan to the lane item's kind, and the shadow replan misreads a document scout report as zero items
